condition: Launch once only after successful worker/host/supervisor closure. Root must compare launcher and reader-review identities above immediately before launch and record actual command/source identity.
scope: Saved files only; no physical/model/training/fitting calls, no re-execution of old experiments.
review_findings: Dynamic run and reader review paths; exclusive execution/output paths.
Child runs without LD_PRELOAD/LD_LIBRARY_PATH/DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY and uses frozen installed Python package location for NumPy.
All reviewed source identities checked before and after; one-MiB hash-loop deadline checks; completion booleans and partial postcheck count prevent misreporting an incomplete check as clean.
Child waiting ends early enough to reserve nominal postcheck time; termination reaps child.
Missing output, any source mismatch, incomplete pre/post checks, exception or elapsed>1200 causes nonzero failure. Actual elapsed is reported.
validation_note: Current launcher source was read directly. No new tests or execution by reviewer. An earlier AST parse, if reported, is not claimed to validate this later revision.
